Ond's second beta is here so the first can install it. If you have 0.7.0-beta.1, Settings › About offers this one: Download, then Restart to Update. Nothing else changes.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.2-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.2-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on x86_64, glibc 2.39 or newer |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.2-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, same requirements |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.2-windows-x86_64.zip` | Windows 10 and 11 |

The `.minisig` files are signatures. Ond checks a download against them before it installs an update.

### Please report

If the update doesn't install, Settings › About says why. Please report it with your OS, how you installed Ond, and that message.
